name: Leon Panetta
role: US congressman (1977–1993), OMB director, White House chief of staff, CIA director, Defense Secretary
summary: Panetta is a centrist Democrat who chaired the House Budget Committee and stressed deficit discipline. He backed civil rights, gun controls and open military service, and as defence and intelligence chief held a strong-defence, checks-and-balances outlook.
